scope: 1024-point three-band and RGB overview waveforms; not scrolling high-resolution waveforms or music metadata analysis.

criteria.exact: Complete decompressed header, 1024-point channel array, and footer are identical.
criteria.song_pass: Both three-band and RGB outputs must be exact or near.

selection: Two disjoint 50-song batches selected by predetermined seeded ordering within codec/rate strata, excluding previously revealed IDs, normalized titles, and content identities. Predictions and source were frozen before native import.
limitations: All samples are stereo and from one private music collection.
44.1 and 48 kHz MP3, AAC, FLAC, and signed 16-bit little-endian WAV PCM were tested.
No statistical claim of universal compatibility or a whole-library success rate is made.
Mono, other codecs/rates, different decoder builds, other operating systems, and hardware playback are not validated by these runs.
These counts validate the standalone algorithm. They do not by themselves prove a subsequently modified rb2engine integration.
The 120 development samples are reported separately and do not count as independent holdout validation.
privacy: Only anonymous sample labels, codec/rate, numeric comparisons, environment versions, and algorithm provenance are included. No titles, artists, personal paths, audio, audio hashes, or library databases are distributed.

runs.description: Previously revealed samples; rerun after development fixes. Not independent validation.
